info.title: API-DocTest-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API allows users to track and manage the status of their auto insurance quotes. This endpoint provides real-time updates on various quoting processes, ensuring users can easily monitor their applications. Typical consumers include insurance agents, customers seeking clarity on the status of their quotes, and customer service representatives helping with inquiries. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance user experience and streamline communication regarding quote status.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of quotes in the system. It provides information on whether quotes are pending, approved, or rejected, helping users track their quote submissions effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of quotes. Ensure the request is properly formatted according to the specified schema to obtain accurate responses.
